Superadditivity of phi and psi follows termwise from nonnegative convex sequences with zero constant, giving lower bounds E1*=n/(a+1)+1/(n-1)+2d/[(n-2)(n-1)] and E2*=n/d+d[2/((n-2)(n-1))+n/(b(b+1))]. Independently re-expanded the cleared integer polynomial with u=A-2,v=d-1,w=b-d>=0: exhaustive domains u>=v and v>=u yield 143 and 148 nonzero monomials respectively, each coefficient strictly positive (minimum 1). Thus E1* E2* - E2* -2E1* >=0 for all parameters, not merely sampled instances. Geometric thinning covers zero columns.
